LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_MasterTip: Masters always have trainer status. Actual training still requires the appropriate work settings and permission for the target.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_UnsetTip: Unassigned identities cannot be trainers. Masters always qualify; sex slaves must develop the Training Officer specialization.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_SlaveTip: This saves the personal trainer choice. A qualified Training Officer may turn it on, subject to work requirements and target permission. Losing qualification pauses trainer status but preserves the choice. Turning it off retains assignments as inactive and lets training already underway finish.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_QualificationTip: Trainer status requires 20% progress in the current Training Officer specialization or an active final Training Officer state, plus free colonist status, a bound master, and the required chain stage. This pawn does not currently qualify.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_Failure_ChainStageTo: Requires the submissive sex slave chain stage
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_Failure_FinalDisable: Final Training Officer state is currently disabled
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_Failure_WrongSpecial: Training Officer is not the current specialization
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_FinalDisabledPending: Final state remains disabled until status maintenance restores it
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_RestrictionTip: While ongoing conditions are met, selecting this specialization can force permission for this pawn to initiate consensual or forced acts. The 20% threshold only gates trainer status. Global switches and source priority still apply to forced rules.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_Required: Requires trainer status: a master, or a qualified Training Officer sex slave with the trainer option enabled.
